about: Harry's question board for PatchTown Works (the town hall card). Made from DECISIONS.md, 'The top 5'. One entry per open decision: id (as in DECISIONS.md), q (the plain question), default (the recommended answer), if_silent (what happens if Harry says nothing), type (money, security, deleting, downloads or taste), asked (when it was first asked: the commit that added DECISIONS.md), blocks (what it holds up), status (open, yes, no or withdrawn). When Harry answers in the town chat, set status to his answer; the board and the mood line count only open ones.

asks.q: Let Claude Code write the town's diary by itself (hooks)?
Let a GitHub workflow publish one town file every few minutes?
Keep the repo public, or move the work to a private repo?
asks.default: Keep it for now; decide again before going public
asks.if_silent: It stays public as it is now

asks.q: Download the free Kenney model kits for the new look?
asks.default: Yes (you download; the build machine is blocked)

asks.q: A check every 30 minutes that wakes a foreman only when something stalls?
asks.default: Yes (uses a little of the plan, only when it fires)
asks.blocks: the stall watcher outside the session

more.text: 54 more questions are in DECISIONS.md, each with a recommended answer: 23 about security, money, downloads or deleting (silence means no) and 31 taste calls (each takes its recommended answer after 3 quiet days).
